from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-seq0/frozen/seen/play/users/u038/system/state/workspace/programs/task-28e52271.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''from collections import Counter, deque

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    outside = [[False] * w for _ in range(h)]
    q = deque()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in (0, w - 1):
            if grid[r][c] == background and not outside[r][c]:
                outside[r][c] = True
                q.append((r, c))
    for c in range(w):
        for r in (0, h - 1):
            if grid[r][c] == background and not outside[r][c]:
                outside[r][c] = True
                q.append((r, c))
    while q:
        r, c = q.popleft()
        for nr, nc in ((r - 1, c), (r + 1, c), (r, c - 1), (r, c + 1)):
            if 0 <= nr < h and 0 <= nc < w and not outside[nr][nc] and grid[nr][nc] == background:
                outside[nr][nc] = True
                q.append((nr, nc))
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == background and not outside[r][c]:
                out[r][c] = 4
    return out
'''
